note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All buildings, names and data are fictional and illustrative. The two scenes differ only in the supplied datum; neither is presented as correct, and no legal consequence is shown. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision 2026-09-26 (standing rule, AUTHORING item 20): after trying a right-hand text column (rejected: scenes at ~40% width), full-width stacked scenes and plan crops, near-maximum stress text does not fit 1:1 at >= 16 px (measured: strip 565 design units at 16.6 px vs about 480 available with people >= 60 px); stress field lengths capped to the longest tried values that fit every ratio (1:1 strip 483 units at 16.6 px, people 60.5 px); every field stays strictly longer than baseline and counts stay >= baseline.
